$comment: Declared operations — the app's VERBS, discoverable and callable by the CraftBot agent via the livingui CLI (`livingui <project> --help` lists them; `livingui <project> run <op> --params-file p.json` executes). Plain CRUD needs NO ops: every entity in config/schema.json already has generated REST endpoints AND the CLI's built-in data commands (select/count/insert/update/delete/sql) work on its tables directly. Declare an op for every side-effectful capability beyond CRUD — typically one op per custom route in routes.py, plus sql/shell ops where no route is needed. Write descriptions that say WHEN to use the op; agents choose ops by reading them. Full spec: the living-ui-creator skill's OPERATIONS.md. Ops may also declare "schedule": "every 15m" | "every 2h" | "hourly" | "daily HH:MM" — the platform runs them automatically while the app is running (no params passed; defaults must suffice; results in logs/schedule.log).

http.$how: params become the JSON body (query params for GET/DELETE). Pair with a custom route in routes.py.
http.description: Archive every card whose status is done. Use when the user asks to clean up the board.

sql.$how: params bind as :named parameters — never string-substituted. No route needed.
sql.description: Move every card from one column to another in a single statement.

executor.sql: UPDATE card SET column_id = :toId WHERE column_id = :fromId

shell.$how: declared command caged in the project dir; {param} values are validated and quoted. Use mode 'job' for long-running work, then poll with `livingui <project> job <id>`.
shell.description: Export all data to a timestamped JSON file under exports/.

reset.description: Reset the application state to empty. Use when the user asks to clear everything or start over.

export.description: Export every table to a timestamped JSON file under exports/. Use for backups or when the user asks to export their data.
